mapper.sql: SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM payments p GROUP BY p.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.customer_order_no AS customerOrderNo, o.customer_id AS customerId, c.name AS customerName, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, COALESCE(t.paid_amount, 0) AS paidAmount, o.total_amount - COALESCE(t.paid_amount, 0) AS balance, s.shipment_date AS shipmentDate, o.due_date AS dueDate FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN shipments s ON o.id = s.order_id LEFT JOIN () t ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY s.shipment_date ASC
SELECT o.status AS status, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status
